seo.keywords: Al Sirat Ul Mustaqeem Foundation, student fee aid Pakistan, education charity, school fee support, donate education Pakistan, needy students, apply for educational aid, الصراط المستقیم فاؤنڈیشن
seo.homeDescription: Help needy students stay in school. Al Sirat Ul Mustaqeem Foundation provides board-reviewed education aid paid directly to schools across Pakistan.
seo.aboutDescription: Learn how Al Sirat Ul Mustaqeem Foundation supports orphan and low-income students with transparent, school-directed fee assistance.
seo.applyDescription: Apply online for student fee support. Submit school documents and track your application with a reference number and CNIC.
seo.donateDescription: Donate via bank transfer, JazzCash, or EasyPaisa. Your gift helps needy children continue education through school-paid support.
seo.contactDescription: Contact Al Sirat Ul Mustaqeem Foundation for education aid questions, donations, or partnership inquiries in Pakistan.
seo.statusDescription: Check your educational aid application or donation report status using your reference number.

home.heroText: We support deserving students so they can continue education with dignity and trust. Approved aid is paid directly to the school after board review.
home.heroScript: Every child deserves a chance to learn, grow and dream.
home.whoText: Al Sirat Ul Mustaqeem Foundation is a non-profit dedicated to keeping needy children in school. We review each case carefully and pay approved aid directly to schools—never as cash to families.
home.visionText: A future where every deserving child has access to quality education, dignity, and the freedom to choose their own path.
home.do1Text: School fee assistance paid directly to schools after board review.
home.do2Text: Help with uniforms and classroom essentials when families cannot afford them.
home.do3Text: Learning resources that keep students ready for class and exams.
home.do4Text: Support with dignity so children can continue studying with confidence.
home.galleryScript: Real people, real stories, real impact
home.help1Text: Cover a student's school fees and help them stay in class.
home.help2Text: Give through bank transfer, JazzCash, or EasyPaisa.
home.help3Text: Want to volunteer or partner with us? Reach the foundation team.
home.transparencyText: Aid decisions are board-reviewed. Approved support goes to schools so every rupee serves education.
home.update1Text: Every application is researched before approval so support reaches the right students.
home.update2Text: Approved fees are paid to schools—not handed as cash to families.
home.update3Text: Submit documents online and track your case with your reference number.
home.ctaBanner: Together, we can open the door to a better future.
home.statusHint: Already applied or donated? Check status with your reference number.

about.title: About the foundation
about.intro: We exist so financial hardship never ends a child's education.
about.p1: Al Sirat Ul Mustaqeem Foundation exists so that financial hardship does not end a child’s education.
about.p2: Applications are reviewed by our board. Approved aid is transferred directly to the student’s school—not as cash to families.
about.p3: Our motto: every child continues to study.
about.pillar1Text: Approved support goes to the school as fees—so help reaches the classroom.
about.pillar2Text: Each case is researched and decided with care, dignity, and accountability.
about.pillar3Text: Donors and families can trust that support is used only for education.

apply.title: Apply for educational aid
apply.intro: Fill this form carefully. Upload fee challan, B-Form, and income certificate.

apply.emailReceiptHint: If you entered an email, a copy of this reference was also sent there.

apply.hasDisability: Does the student have a disability?
apply.docsHint: PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP — max 5MB each.
apply.declaration: I declare that the information is true. I understand aid is paid to the school if approved.

donate.intro2: Your donation helps children continue their education.

status.title: Check status
status.intro: Enter your aid application reference and CNIC, or a donation reference (ASM-DON-…) with your mobile number.
status.hint: Donation references start with ASM-DON-. Application references start with ASM-.
status.error: Could not find a matching record
status.pendingNote: Your application is with the board. Please check again later.
status.approvedNote: The foundation will contact you for next steps. Aid is paid directly to your school.
status.rejectedNote: This application was not approved. Contact the foundation if you have questions.
status.donationPendingNote: The board is still verifying this payment. Please check again later.
status.donationConfirmedNote: JazakAllah khair — your donation has been confirmed by the foundation.
status.donationRejectedNote: This report could not be matched. Contact the foundation with your reference and proof if you need help.
